text:
maria: Quick kickoff 10m. We need a compact playbook for the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private): final hero lines, one benchmark card, gated appendix on webinar reg, and clear lead routing. Two-week timeline?
aj: Two weeks works. Suggest pre-launch post 48h before webinar. CTA test: "Get started" vs "Talk to sales" families.
noah: I'll produce 3 hero lockups in Figma (engineering, ROI, compliance) and export desktop/mobile by Fri.
sam: I'll prepare a single comparison stat (p95 delta) and a 1-paragraph benchmark blurb + CSV methodology.
tess: Building webinar landing + HubSpot form. Plan to include hidden field `mode` set by page links. Routing: hosted -> inbound SDR, dedicated -> AE queue, private -> AE+SE.
maria: UTMs: utm_campaign=tri_mode_quick and utm_content=hero_variant. Gate "latency-appendix.pdf" behind reg. Default hero = Hosted if no mode param.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy window next Wed 08:00 PT. Put final assets in /releases/marketing by Tue 18:00 PT.
maria: Action items: noah Figma (Fri), sam benchmark + CSV (Thu), tess landing + workflow (Mon), aj social + post (Mon). Short dry-run Mon EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
